name: HEKTAR
recent: Hektar REIT 在2026年11月12日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，净产业收入按年上升3.5%，主要由于营运改善和成本优化。公司于11月9日宣布取消原定11月16日举行的特别股东大会，并撤回以1.25亿林吉特收购KYS KL East International School的提案，原因是卖方未能满足多项先决条件。此外，主要股东UPAYAPADU (M) SDN. BHD. 在10月至11月期间多次申报股权变动。
notable: 公司终止以1.25亿林吉特收购KYS KL East International School的买卖协议，因卖方未能满足多项先决条件，定金将退还予受托人。
公司取消原定2026年11月16日举行的特别股东大会，该会议原为表决上述收购及租赁提案。
公司宣布2026年第二季度每单位1.21仙的中期分派，除权日为9月9日，派发日为10月9日。
risks: 主要股东UPAYAPADU (M) SDN. BHD. 在2026年10月至11月期间多次申报股权变动，另有UPAYAPADU SAUJANA SDN BHD 于11月11日申报成为主要股东。
收购KYS KL East International School的提案已终止，相关特别股东大会亦已取消。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为3192万林吉特，按年微跌0.2%，按季升2.9%；净利为623万林吉特，按年升33.6%，按季升34.0%；净利率为19.5%，高于上一季度的15.0%。

recent_en: Hektar REIT announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 12 November 2026, with net property income rising 3.5% year-on-year on improved operations and cost optimisation. On 9 November, the company cancelled the extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 16 November and withdrew its RM125 million proposed acquisition of KYS KL East International School after the vendor failed to fulfil several conditions precedent. Meanwhile, substantial shareholder UPAYAPADU (M) SDN. BHD. filed multiple changes in shareholding between October and November.
notable_en: The company terminated the sale and purchase agreement to acquire KYS KL East International School for RM125 million after the vendor failed to fulfil several conditions precedent; the deposit will be refunded to the trustee.
The company cancelled the extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 16 November 2026, which was to vote on the proposed acquisition and lease.
The company declared an interim distribution of 1.21 sen per unit for the second quarter of 2026, with ex-date on 9 September and payment date on 9 October.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder UPAYAPADU (M) SDN. BHD. filed multiple changes in shareholding between October and November 2026, while UPAYAPADU SAUJANA SDN BHD notified its interest as a substantial shareholder on 11 November.
The proposed acquisition of KYS KL East International School has been terminated and the related extraordinary general meeting cancelled.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM31.92 million, down 0.2% year-on-year but up 2.9% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM6.23 million, up 33.6% year-on-year and 34.0% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 19.5%, higher than 15.0% in the previous quarter.
